key_idea: Put the pieces together and see what shape they make.
steps: The two triangles fit together along their long sides into a square, just as big as the pink square.
Put that square next to the pink square.
Two squares side by side make a rectangle that is twice as long as it is tall.

choice_feedback.A: This shape is too small. The square and both triangles would not fit inside it.
choice_feedback.B: This shape is too small. The square and both triangles would not fit inside it.
choice_feedback.C: A circle is round all the way around, but all the pieces have straight sides.
choice_feedback.E: This shape is too small. The square and both triangles would not fit inside it.

review.note: Key D confirmed from the drawings (D is exactly two squares). But the choice texts 'parallelogram' and 'triangle' name shapes these pieces can make at other sizes (a slanted parallelogram, or a big right triangle); only the drawn sizes rule A and E out.
